checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: All footage from original, no generated replacement or speed changes
must.why: Redrawn by an AI video editor at 480p; the agent itself says so. Frames look regenerated.

must.item: Edit favors action over boring parts
must.why: A blind single stretch (11-19s) was picked, not selected for action.

must.item: Cuts preserve action, no chopped speech
must.why: Single stretch, but speech cannot be judged. Burned-in subtitles appear.

must.item: Original audio in sync, no added narration, music or text
must.why: Subtitles were added or redrawn in the frames, and audio sync cannot be verified.

faults.what: Footage is regenerated, not the original; the pilot's helmet and mask change between frames and the cockpit looks AI-made.
Subtitle text appears in the output, which the user did not ask for.
No boring-part selection was made; the segment was chosen blind.
Low resolution (480p) with visible AI artefacts.

summary: The output is an 8-second AI-redrawn clip of seconds 11-19 with subtitles added, not a true trim of the original footage, and the segment was chosen blind.
